_help: The macro list window in 1366x768 space. dockX/dockY = where it opens, as a step from the skill window top-left (the skill window is 318 wide, so 320 touches its right side). w/h = the window size (the official art is 184x361). titleH = the title strip you drag it by. panelX/panelY = the light body panel, listX/listY = the official list art (five rows of slots, the name box and the check box). slotX = the left of the first skill slot, slotStep = the step between the three slots, slotW/slotH = one slot, iconX/iconW/iconH = the macro icon of a row, rowY = the top of the first row, rowPitch = the step between rows. closeX = the gap from the right edge to the X button, closeY = its top, closeW/closeH = its size. Keys may be omitted (keeps the default).
